question: After development and the planned diagnostic comparison, the 102-column model had a lower primary macro-MAE than the chosen 99-column model. Test the frozen models on both entire archived driving cohorts left out of this experiment.
selection: Use the 102-column model over the 99-column model only if it lowers MAE by at least .003 on BOTH reserved cohorts, with no lower global 10% or window 10% hit count in either cohort for every one of the original three seeds. Otherwise keep the 99-column choice. No refits or further feature searches.
limits: Both collections have been studied by the team previously; these are transfer diagnostics, not prospective validation on an untouched map. Adjacent frames are correlated.
window: 64-frame consecutive bins reset per manifest, ceil 10% for each bin. Check frame number order against source IDs.
bootstrap: 50m spatial cells shared across passes, 2000 draws; seed 23411
